html:
Guatemala City is the capital of Guatemala and the largest city of Central America. The Spanish moved their capital here, to the Valley of the Hermitage, after earthquakes wrecked Antigua; it was officially founded in 1776.

It was built on a grid around a central square, over the old Kaminaljuyu. It was the capital of the Central American federation after independence in 1821, and then of Guatemala. Earthquakes in 1917 and 1918 and in 1976 badly damaged it.

In the 1900s it grew quickly as people fled poverty and the civil war in the countryside, many settling in ravines around the centre. It holds the national palace, the cathedral and most of the country's industry, and about a fifth of its people.
sum: Guatemala City is the capital of Guatemala and the largest city of Central America. The Spanish moved their capital here, to the Valley of the Hermitage, after earthquakes wrecked Antigua; it was officially founded in 1776.
